lemmas.statement: The meson-side output of QM-221 is the pair of channel coefficients -4/3 and 1/6 on a quark‑antiquark colour decomposition.
lemmas.lean_skeleton:
by
  have h := R_meson_channel_coeffs
  exact h

open_obligations: Define a finite Meson carrier with a concrete colour contraction yielding the singlet and octet coefficients.
Provide a concrete construction of the meson composite operation linking channel coefficients to the Meson carrier.
